header.userPrompt:
Persist how each bank statement was extracted.

The extraction ladder already tags its output: AiStatementExtractor.ExtractionResult.source holds the stage that produced the kept result (stamped by StatementExtractionService). Surface that and persist it on drafts and confirmed statements.

1. Add an ExtractionSource enum, mirroring the existing ProductType enum exactly (same library, module/location and style). Four values, stored as these strings: pdf_text, bda_markdown, textract_tables, bda_custom. They correspond 1:1 to the four ladder stages in StatementExtractionService.extract (PDF text; BDA markdown; Textract tables + text + BDA markdown; BDA custom output). Change ExtractionResult.source and the ladder's stamping to use this enum instead of the current Option[String], so each stage name lives in one place. Update StatementPipelineEval (it reads result.source) to match.

2. Define a small, typed ExtractionInfo holding exactly: stage: ExtractionSource, model: String, reconciled: Boolean, discrepancy: Option[String]. No freeform map. Put it where both the server and the shared API models can use it (mirror where ProductType / the draft payload models live).

3. Draft: in ExtractBankStatementDraftAction.toPayload, add the extraction stage to the ready draft payload (which already carries model, reconciled, discrepancy), taken from result.source. Do not fabricate a value when source is absent - leave it optional.

4. Confirmed statement: add a nullable jsonb column extraction_info to the confirmed bank statement table via a single new Play evolution (no !Downs, no DB default, named constraints if any). In ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction, assemble ExtractionInfo from the draft payload and store it through the repository/DAO. Nullable, no backfill.

5. Return extractionInfo in the GetBankStatement API response so it is visible. No frontend/UI work is in scope.

Scope: persistence + API read only. Keep the enum app-side only (a plain string column in Postgres, no Postgres enum type). Add/adjust tests per docs/guide/testing.md.

resultJson.description:
Record how each bank statement was extracted, and keep that record. The statement-extraction ladder (`StatementExtractionService.extract`) already tags its kept result with the rung that produced it, but the tag is a freeform `Option[String]` ("PDF text", "BDA markdown", …). It is thrown away when the draft payload is built and never reaches the confirmed statement. This epic makes the tag a typed, app-side enum (`ExtractionSource`: pdf_text / bda_markdown / textract_tables / bda_custom), so each stage name is defined in exactly one place. The stage then travels with the data: from the ladder, into the draft payload, and onto the confirmed `bank_statement` row.

On confirm, a small typed `ExtractionInfo(stage, model, reconciled, discrepancy)` is built from the draft payload. It is stored in a new nullable `extraction_info JSONB` column, added by one new Play evolution (4.sql) with no backfill and no DB default. `GetBankStatement` returns it as `extractionInfo: Option[ExtractionInfo]`, so the information can be seen through the API. Values are never made up. A draft whose payload has no stage (older drafts, or results the ladder never tagged) leaves `stage` as `None`, and a statement confirmed from such a draft gets `extraction_info = NULL` and `extractionInfo = None`.

Scope is persistence plus API read only: no frontend or UI work, no Postgres enum type (a plain JSONB column; the stage is stored as its entry-name string inside it). Tests follow docs/guide/testing.md: repository specs on a real DB, controller specs for the API, and no direct action tests.

tasks.title: Introduce ExtractionSource enum and retype the ladder's source tag
tasks.description:
Create `lib/api/shared/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/api/models/bankstatementtemplates/ExtractionSource.scala`, copying `ProductType.scala` in the same package exactly: `sealed abstract class ExtractionSource(val entryName: String)`; case objects `PdfText("pdf_text")`, `BdaMarkdown("bda_markdown")`, `TextractTables("textract_tables")`, `BdaCustom("bda_custom")`; `values`; `fromEntryName` (throws NoSuchElementException on an unknown name); an implicit play-json `Format` that reads and writes the entryName string and gives a JsError on unknown values; `implicit val schema = Schema.string[ExtractionSource]`. Add a one-line doc comment like ProductType's.

In `server/.../services/AiStatementExtractor.scala`, change `ExtractionResult.source` to `Option[ExtractionSource] = None` and update its comment. In `server/.../services/StatementExtractionService.scala`, change the `stage`/`name` params of `extractReconciling` and the local `rung` helper from String to ExtractionSource. Pass `ExtractionSource.PdfText` for r1, `BdaMarkdown` for r2, `TextractTables` for r3 and `BdaCustom` for r4, stamp `parsed.copy(source = Some(stage))`, and use `stage.entryName` in the log lines. Do NOT reuse or merge the unrelated cache-key `private val BdaCustomType = "bda_custom"`. In `server/.../scripts/StatementPipelineEval.scala` line ~107, write `result.source.map(_.entryName).getOrElse("unknown")` (keep the existing eval-only label) and fix the scaladoc mention if needed.

Tests: add `lib/api/shared/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/api/models/bankstatementtemplates/ExtractionSourceSpec.scala` (AnyWordSpec, see ImportRuleMatcherSpec in the same test tree for style). It should check that each of the four values round-trips through Json.toJson/validate as exactly its string, that an unknown string gives a JsError, and that `fromEntryName` works for every value. Check that `AiStatementExtractorSpec` still compiles and passes; parseAndVerify still leaves source = None. Verify: `CI=true sbt Test/compile` and the relevant tests pass.

tasks.title: Carry the extraction stage on the ready draft payload
tasks.description:
In `lib/api/shared/.../api/models/bankstatements/BankStatementDraft.scala`, add `stage: Option[ExtractionSource]` to `BankStatementDraft.Payload`, after `model`, with no constructor default; import from `bankstatementtemplates`. Json.format reads a missing key as None, so drafts already stored without the key still parse. In `server/.../actions/bankstatements/ExtractBankStatementDraftAction.toPayload`, set `stage = result.source`, passing the Option straight through and never inventing a value. Fix every other `Payload(` construction site: currently only `server/src/test/scala/controllers/BankStatementDraftControllerSpec.scala` `reconcilingPayload`, where you set e.g. `stage = Some(ExtractionSource.BdaMarkdown)`. `UpdateBankStatementDraftAction` uses `payload.copy`, so the stage the client round-trips is kept. The web only uses `.copy`, so it needs no change, but confirm `CI=true sbt web/compile`.

Tests (BankStatementDraftControllerSpec): (a) GET of a seeded ready draft returns `payload.value.stage` equal to the seeded stage; (b) a draft seeded with a payload JSON that has no `stage` key (e.g. `Json.toJson(payload).as[JsObject] - "stage"` passed to markReady) is still readable, with `stage = None`. Verify: `CI=true sbt Test/compile` + `server/testOnly controllers.BankStatementDraftControllerSpec`.

tasks.title: Persist ExtractionInfo on confirmed statements (evolution + repository + confirm action)
tasks.description:
1) Create `lib/api/shared/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/api/models/bankstatements/ExtractionInfo.scala`: `case class ExtractionInfo(stage: ExtractionSource, model: String, reconciled: Boolean, discrepancy: Option[String])` with a companion holding `implicit val format = Json.format[ExtractionInfo]` and `implicit val schema = Schema.derived[ExtractionInfo].name(Schema.SName("BankStatementExtractionInfo"))`, in the BankStatementDraft.scala style (imports `sttp.tapir.generic.auto.*`). Exactly these four fields, no map.

2) Add `server/src/main/resources/evolutions/default/4.sql`: a `-- !Ups` header only (no !Downs) and `ALTER TABLE bank_statement ADD COLUMN extraction_info JSONB;`. Nullable, no DEFAULT, no CHECK, no backfill. Add a short comment documenting the shape and the allowed stage strings (pdf_text/bda_markdown/textract_tables/bda_custom). This must be the only evolution file on the branch.

3) DAO and repository (`server/.../repositories/daos/BankStatementDAO.scala`, `BankStatementRepository.scala`, `models/BankStatementView.scala`):
- Add `extractionInfo: Option[ExtractionInfo]` to `BankStatementView`.
- Change `BankStatementDAO.create(stmt, metadata, extractionInfo: Option[ExtractionInfo])` to insert `extraction_info` via `extractionInfo.map(Json.toJson(_))`, using the existing `jsValueOptionToStatement` in `daos/package.scala`, which writes a jsonb PGobject or a NULL.
- Select `bs.extraction_info` in both `find` and `all` SQL and parse it in `viewParser`. Preferably add an `implicit val extractionInfoColumn: Column[ExtractionInfo]` in daos/package.scala built on `jsValueColumn.mapResult(js => js.validate[ExtractionInfo].asEither.left.map(e => TypeDoesNotMatch(...)))`, so bad JSON fails loudly, and read it with `get[Option[ExtractionInfo]]("extraction_info")`.
- Add an `extractionInfo: Option[ExtractionInfo]` param to `createConfirmedStatement`. Legacy `create(stmt, metadata, rows)` passes None.
- Leave the `BankStatement` case class / `parser` / `metadataColumns` unchanged; they aren't needed.

4) In `ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction`, build `extractionInfo = payload.stage.map(s => payload.into[ExtractionInfo].withFieldConst(_.stage, s).transform)`. Use Chimney (`io.scalaland.chimney.dsl.*`), because model/reconciled/discrepancy line up by name and RULE-BE-008 plus the coding-patterns reviewer require it. Pass it to `createConfirmedStatement`. A None stage gives NULL; never make one up.

5) Update `server/src/test/scala/controllers/common/PlayPostgresSpec.createBankStatementWithRows` to pass None, or add an optional `extractionInfo` param defaulting to None for tests.

Tests (`server/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/repositories/BankStatementRepositorySpec.scala`, using RepositoryUtils and no raw-SQL seeding): add a `createConfirmedStatement` block with two cases. (a) With `Some(ExtractionInfo(ExtractionSource.TextractTables, "model-x", reconciled = false, Some("off by 1")))`, `find(id, userId)` returns it unchanged and `all(userId)` includes it. (b) With None, find returns `extractionInfo = None`. Also check that the existing `create` path gives `extractionInfo = None`. Verify: `CI=true sbt Test/compile` + `server/testOnly *BankStatementRepositorySpec`.

tasks.title: Return extractionInfo from the GetBankStatement API
tasks.description:
In `lib/api/shared/.../api/models/bankstatements/GetBankStatement.scala`, add `extractionInfo: Option[ExtractionInfo]` to `GetBankStatement.Response`, e.g. after `periodEnd` and before `statementRows`. Its Format and Schema come from the ExtractionInfo companion. In `server/.../actions/bankstatements/GetBankStatementAction.scala`, set `extractionInfo = view.extractionInfo`. The only construction site of Response is this action; the web only reads it, so confirm `CI=true sbt web/compile` and make no UI changes.

Tests (controller, booted app; tapir Schema.derived is only safe there): in `server/src/test/scala/controllers/BankStatementDraftControllerSpec.scala` under "POST /bank-statements/drafts/:id/confirm": (a) confirming a draft seeded with `stage = Some(ExtractionSource.BdaMarkdown)`, model "test", reconciled true and discrepancy None returns `client.getBankStatement(stmtId).extractionInfo == Some(ExtractionInfo(ExtractionSource.BdaMarkdown, "test", true, None))`; (b) confirming a draft whose payload has `stage = None` returns `extractionInfo = None`. Optionally, in `BankStatementsControllerSpec`, check that a statement created with `createBankStatement` (PlayPostgresSpec helper) returns `extractionInfo = None`. Verify: `CI=true sbt Test/compile`, run `sbt scalafmtAll scalafmtSbt`, then the full `CI=true NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider sbt test` in the foreground until it exits 0.

resultJson.brief:
MODULES
- lib/api/shared/ (cross-compiled; used by server AND web): Tapir endpoints + request/response models. Bank-statement models live under `net.wiringbits.api.models.bankstatements` (BankStatementDraft.scala, GetBankStatement.scala). `ProductType` lives under `net.wiringbits.api.models.bankstatementtemplates/ProductType.scala`; ExtractionSource goes next to it, ExtractionInfo next to BankStatementDraft. Shared tests: lib/api/shared/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/api/... (example: api/utils/ImportRuleMatcherSpec.scala).
- server/: Play backend. controllers → actions (actions/bankstatements/*) → repositories (repositories/*Repository.scala, Future{database.withX{...}}) → DAOs (repositories/daos/*DAO.scala, raw Anorm SQL + RowParsers). services/ holds the extraction ladder. Repositories already import api models (precedent: ImportRuleAction in ImportRuleRepository/ImportRuleDAO/models/ImportRule).
- web/: Scala.js. Out of scope. It only reads GetBankStatement.Response and uses `.copy` on BankStatementDraft.Payload, so new fields compile without web changes. Still run `CI=true sbt web/compile`.

KEY FILES / FACTS
- ProductType.scala (template to copy exactly): `sealed abstract class ProductType(val entryName: String)`; companion has case objects, `val values: Seq[...]`, `def fromEntryName(name): T` (throws NoSuchElementException(s"Unknown ProductType: $name")), `implicit val format: Format[T] = Format(Reads(_.validate[String].flatMap{...JsError(s"Unknown ...")}), Writes(a => JsString(a.entryName)))`, `implicit val schema: Schema[T] = Schema.string[T]`. Imports: `play.api.libs.json.*`, `sttp.tapir.Schema`.
- server/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/services/AiStatementExtractor.scala: `final case class ExtractionResult(reconciled: Boolean, discrepancy: Option[String], model: String, transactions: List[Txn], metadata: Meta, residual: Option[BigDecimal] = None, source: Option[String] = None)`. `parseAndVerify(raw, model): Either[String, ExtractionResult]` leaves source unset. It already imports ProductType from the shared lib.
- server/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/services/StatementExtractionService.scala: `extract(label, sha256, storageKey, text): Future[ExtractionResult]` runs r1 "PDF text" → r2 "BDA markdown" → r3 "Textract + text + BDA markdown" (combinedRepresentation) → r4 "BDA custom output" through the local `rung(prev, name: String, input)` and `extractReconciling(label, text, attemptNo, prevFailure, bestSoFar, stage: String)`, which stamps `parsed.copy(source = Some(stage))`. Mapping: r1=PdfText/pdf_text, r2=BdaMarkdown/bda_markdown, r3=TextractTables/textract_tables, r4=BdaCustom/bda_custom. WARNING: `private val BdaCustomType = "bda_custom"` there is a textract_cache api_type key. It is the same string but a different concept; leave it alone.
- server/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/scripts/StatementPipelineEval.scala ~line 107: `val producedBy = result.source.getOrElse("unknown")` (eval output label only).
- BankStatementDraft.scala: `Payload(metadata: Metadata, transactions: List[Transaction], reconciled: Boolean, discrepancy: Option[String], model: String)` with `Json.format` + `Schema.derived[...].name(Schema.SName("BankStatementDraftPayload"))`. Every model companion follows this format+named-schema pattern and imports `sttp.tapir.generic.auto.*`. The payload is stored as a JSON string in `bank_statement_draft.payload` (JSONB) via `BankStatementDraftDAO.markReady(id, jsonString, now)` / `updatePayload`. Play-json Json.format reads a missing Option key as None, so old drafts stay readable.
- actions/bankstatements/ExtractBankStatementDraftAction.scala: `private def toPayload(result: AiStatementExtractor.ExtractionResult): ApiDraft.Payload` (hand-built; ApiDraft = api BankStatementDraft alias).
- actions/bankstatements/UpdateBankStatementDraftAction.scala: saves the client-sent payload with `payload.copy(reconciled, discrepancy)` recomputed, so `stage`/`model` round-trip from the client.
- actions/bankstatements/ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction.scala: parses `Json.parse(payloadStr).as[BankStatementDraft.Payload]`, requireReconciled, requireMetadata → `BankStatement.Metadata`, builds Document.Create / BankStatement.Create / rows, then calls `bankStatementRepository.createConfirmedStatement(document, stmt, metadata, rows)`. Note payload.reconciled reflects the latest stored payload (it may have been recomputed after edits); use it as is.
- actions/bankstatements/GetBankStatementAction.scala: builds `GetBankStatement.Response(...)` from `bankStatementRepository.find(id, userId): Option[BankStatementView]` + findRows. This is the ONLY construction site of Response.
- repositories/BankStatementRepository.scala: `create(stmt, metadata, rows)` (used by tests/RepositoryUtils) and `createConfirmedStatement(document, stmt, metadata, rows): Future[UUID]` both call `BankStatementDAO.create(stmt, metadata)` inside withTransaction. Callers of createConfirmedStatement: ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction and test helper server/src/test/scala/controllers/common/PlayPostgresSpec.scala `createBankStatementWithRows`.
- repositories/daos/BankStatementDAO.scala: hand-written `parser` (BankStatement) and `viewParser` (BankStatementView). `find`/`all` SELECT explicit `bs.` columns joined with document plus row counts. `create` uses the SQL"""...""" interpolation with `${...}`.
- repositories/models/BankStatementView.scala, BankStatement.scala (Create(id, documentId, userId, createdAt, updatedAt); Metadata(...)). Leave BankStatement/Create unchanged.
- repositories/daos/package.scala: `jsValueToStatement` (jsonb PGobject), `jsValueOptionToStatement` (Option → setNull OTHER), `jsValueColumn: Column[JsValue]`, `enumColumn` helper. Put any new Column here. Errors use `TypeDoesNotMatch`/`SqlRequestError`.
- Evolutions: server/src/main/resources/evolutions/default/{1,2,3}.sql. 3.sql is the squashed app schema (bank_statement table defined at ~line 168). The next file is 4.sql. Start it with `-- !Ups`; never add `-- !Downs`.

CONVENTIONS (docs/guide/*)
- DB: Anorm raw SQL; writes inside withTransaction; RULE-DB-008 enums stored as TEXT/strings (no SQL ENUM); RULE-DB-010 no CHECK; RULE-DB-014 one evolution file per branch; RULE-DB-016 no DEFAULT; name any constraints explicitly; every user-owned query keeps `WHERE user_id = ...`.
- Backend: actions are flat for-comprehensions; errors are bare RuntimeException (handleRequest → 500). RULE-BE-008 / the orca coding-patterns reviewer require Chimney (`import io.scalaland.chimney.dsl.*`, `src.into[T].withFieldConst(...).transform`) when building a case class from another with fields that match by name. The reviewer also flags stringly-typed fixed sets and silent defaults for missing data. Never make up a stage: absent means None means NULL.
- Testing: AnyWordSpec. The `should` subject is a method or endpoint name, never the class name. Repository specs extend RepositorySpec with RepositoryUtils (real Postgres via testcontainers; seed via RepositoryUtils, not raw SQL). Controller specs extend PlayPostgresSpec with LoginUtils (`withApiClient { implicit client => ... }`, `createVerifyLoginUser(tokenGenerator)`, `client.getBankStatement(id)`, `client.confirmBankStatementDraft(id)`, `client.getBankStatementDraft(id)`). Actions are not tested directly. Use `.futureValue`. Tapir `Schema.derived` models (GetBankStatement.Response etc.) hit a static-init bug outside a booted app (see McpDispatcherSpec notes), so test API responses in controller specs. Plain play-json Format tests on ExtractionSource are fine in isolation.
- Build: `CI=true sbt Test/compile` (-Werror: unused imports and warnings fail), `sbt scalafmtAll scalafmtSbt`, full tests `CI=true NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider sbt test` in the foreground. Do not push.
- No StatementExtractionService or ExtractBankStatementDraftAction specs exist. Don't add mock-heavy ladder tests; enum/format coverage and controller round-trips are enough.

findings.title: [b16036f1] commit message has no body explaining the change

reason.text: Out of scope. b16036f ("stage: Plan") is a stage commit the orca runtime created, not one from this change. Adding a body would mean rewriting a commit that is already in history, and this session isn't allowed to commit or rewrite git history (the runtime manages git). The runtime's own commit flow would have to change this message.
